publisher_or_authors: Shinn, Cassano, Gopinath, Narasimhan, Yao · academic · 2023
summary: Uses verbal self-reflection stored in memory to improve agent performance across attempts without updating parameters. Requires explicit evaluator or task feedback to be productive. A memory-driven feedback loop for agents.
title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
why: Shows feedback-driven improvement depends on an external evaluator signal.
